2.4.7.goal: Users know which element has keyboard focus.
2.4.7.whatToDo: Ensure each item receiving focus has a visible indicator.
2.4.7.whyImportant: Without a focus indicator, sighted keyboard users cannot operate the page.

1.4.12.goal: Users can adjust text spacing to make it easier to read.
1.4.12.authorTask: Ensure content adapts to user-defined text settings.
1.4.12.whyImportant: Some people need text with different spacing or font characteristics.
